the correlation functions of an inhomogeneous XXX chain are rational functions of the in homogeneity parameters, and that these rational functions can be expressed in terms of a certain set of functions, which are the solutions to an algebraic system of linear equations.

for the XXX model with inhomogeneity, (i) the correlation functions of n consecutive sites can be expressed in terms of a single determinant of order n, (ii) the determinant has a specific structure, which makes it possible to obtain a simple expression for its leading asymptotics at large n, and (iii) the leading term of the asymptotic expansion is given by a certain rational function of the inhomogeneities.
the correlators of the inhomogeneous spin chain can be expressed in terms of the correlators of an homogeneous spin chain and of certain rational functions of the in homogeneity parameters.

all the correlators of the inhomogeneous XXX model are expressed by means of a certain set of elementary functions, which can be determined from the knowledge of the correlators of an arbitrary number of sites.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found a new exact solution for the inhomogeneous XXX model, which is based on the Bethe ansatz, but is quite different from the earlier solutions.
, for the first time, the correlation functions of an inhomogeneous integrable quantum spin model are expressed in terms of a set of functions that are known exactly and have a simple structure.
we have found an explicit expression for the correlation functions in terms of the Bethe roots, and that this expression is in agreement with the results of Korepin et al.

the correlation functions of a certain class of integrable quantum models can be expressed as linear combinations of the solutions of a linear system of equations.
